entries.name: Chick
entries.style: chibi cube pet, deliberately blocky (Kenney Cube Pets); height 0.1 m to the head tuft, a real chick (0.08-0.1 m), so it stands a quarter of the library hen (0.4 m) and at a 1.7 m adult ankle; rigid parts moved by node tracks, no skin; colour map flattened to flat colours

source.author: Kenney (kenney.nl)
source.note: The plan names no source for row 30. Two CC0 candidates were rendered: Quaternius Animals Pack (opengameart.org/content/5-low-poly-animals) Chick.fbx, and this Kenney Cube Pets chick. The Quaternius one, at 0.1 m, has an adult hen silhouette (long neck, tail, long legs) and reads as a small hen, not a chick, with one walk-like clip (ArmatureAction.002) and grey source materials. The Kenney chick is a round yellow ball with big eyes, a beak and a head tuft, reads as a chick at hero size, and has eight clips (static, idle, walk, run, eat, dance, gesture-positive, gesture-negative). Recoloured on indigo: the yellow and darker wing-yellow colour-map clusters -> coat (practical yellow, iris orange shade), the orange beak and feet clusters -> beak (accent red, sky shade; an orange beak on the orange coat shade disappears), the white cluster -> sclera, the slate cluster -> eye. The gestures (a nod and a head shake) keep their source names and play once. Ground: eat dips the beak into the ground while the feet stay planted (sinkAllowed); run hops as authored. Ingested through Blender like the other Cube Pets.
